title: Juicy Japanese Apples Udon
description: A citrusy and snappy Japanese dish from Tohoku, featuring bramley apples and tempered chocolate, served in a copper pot. This halal-friendly udon recipe is perfect for a quick breakfast or lunch.
instructions: Heat 2 cups of vegetable broth in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the ginger and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the udon noodles and cook according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, sugar, and 2 cups of vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Temper the chocolate by heating it to 105°F, then cooling it to 82°F.
Add the tempered chocolate to the soy sauce mixture and stir until combined.
Add the chopped green onions and stir to combine.
To serve, place the cooked udon noodles in the copper pot and pour the chocolate-soy sauce mixture over the top.
Garnish with peeled ginger slices and serve immediately.
